searchText: HI all, would like to ask a few questions about the deposit smart contract for phase 0 Is there an exit function for users to withdraw ETH if the deposit contract does not have the minimum amount of ETH to activate Phase 0 ? No, the contract is supposed to slowly build up to the amount. Otherwise some parties could troll the launch. The new starting amount is much lower than before, reachable by even a single party, so I don't think you need to worry about it Thanks <@387303511626350593>
